articles.title: Tamara Keith and Amy Walter on Trump's payout promises
articles.whatHappened: NPR's Tamara Keith and Amy Walter of the Cook Political Report with Amy Walter join Geoff Bennett to discuss the latest political news, including President Trump continuing to promise payouts to voters if Republicans win in the midterms, the GOP spending campaign money and playing defense in typically Republican districts and the White House again barring a media outlet from the press pool.

articles.title: Supreme Court hears case on holding energy companies liable for climate change
articles.whatHappened: Supreme Court justices heard arguments in a major climate change case that could shape how communities hold industries accountable. Officials in Boulder, Colorado, are seeking compensation from energy companies for the costs of natural disasters they say are caused by climate change. Ali Rogin discussed more with News Hour Supreme Court analyst and SCOTUSBlog cofounder Amy Howe.
articles.significance: Judicial & Constitutional Impact: Sets a key legal precedent affecting federal enforcement, constitutional rights, and how lower courts interpret national law.

articles.whatHappened: The announcement comes after Trump hosted top executives of AI companies at the White House last week and said they had signed a voluntary accord that would effectively self-police the development of the technology.
